both engines is 2500 rpm. Company to provide performance information including heat rejection,
fuel consumption, air flow, etc.

Transverse.
Requested Engine Oil: Foggia should deliver the engine filled to the proper level with oil. Customer_C
request is to continue to use SAE 10W40 API CK4 for factory fill and to recommend SAE 0W40 CK4
oil for cold weather. Customer_C also recommends 10W30 and 15W40 oil in operator manuals.
ATS design life to meet or exceed 8000 hours

Starter: Company is to quote the engines with the starter included. The goal is to have a common
starter between the Engine_E5FC and Engine_E2F8 (PR23143). Even if a common part number is not possible, the
connections should be the same size and location so the vehicle side harness will have common
connectors/hardware/installation torque. The current starter is Customer_C part number 90****22 which
is a 3.2kW starter made by MAHLE. Company has proposed starter 580****508 for the Engine_E2F8. This is a
nose-less 3.2kW starter from MAHLE.
Alternator: Company to quote the engine with the alternator included. Required output is 145A at
12V for the Engine_E5FC. The higher output is required to support the additional loads of the DeNOx
system. The goal is to have common mounting for the alternators the Engine_E5FC and Engine_E2F8 (PR23143).
Even if common mounting is not possible, the connections should be the same size and location
so the vehicle side harness will have common connectors/hardware/installation torque. The
current alternators used in Plant-WI are 84****90 (120A) and 51****63 (145A). The 120A
alternator is currently used on the 55kW Engine_E5FC engine with DOC only ATS. The 145A alternator is
used on the 67 and 85kw Engine_E5FC/36 engines with SCR/SCT-T ATS.

grooves to drive the air conditioner compressor is required.
Fan Belt: Company to quote the engine with the fan belt. The goal is also to have a common
serpentine belt between the Engine_E2F8 and Engine_E5FC.

the Machine_CE_C Engine_E5FC engine 92****53.
Engine oil dipstick: Needs to be engine mounted and included with the shipped engine. Dipstick
needs to be accessible from rear of vehicle (fan end).
Fuel Filters: Fuel pre-filter and final filter to be included with engine.
Engine Electrical Connector: Goal is to have a common connector between Engine_E2F8 and Engine_E5FC to allow a
common harness.
Flywheel and Flywheel Housing: Customer_C accepts the current flywheel and housing used on Machine_CESSL/CTL
F32/34/36 engines. Plant-WI will continue to use SAE 6-1/2 flexible coupler number 87****85
Engine Mounted ATS: Company to quote with engine mounted ATS to be designed and delivered
pre-assembled to engine. ATS should be transverse mounted above the flywheel housing. The ATS
for the 85kW Engine_E5FC will be TiV SCR-only.
PTO: Company to quote with and without PTO option. Customer_C will mount a hydraulic pump to drive the
cooling fan if the PTO is a reasonable cost. Pump Input Shaft - 13 tooth, 16/32 pitch splined
input shaft per SAE J744 (25-4, ISO 3019-1).  Pump Mounting Flange - Pump must use two bolt B
style mounting flange per SAE J744 (ISO 3019-1).

components required from Customer_C. No pressure relief valve required from Customer_C.
Engine Oil Fill: Customer_C accepts engine without oil fill neck. Customer_C will source and install the oil
fill neck and cap.
Engine Oil Filter: Request is to have a common location in the left rear as installed in the
vehicle like the Engine_E2F8. This location is accessible from rear of vehicle with no remote oil
filter required from Customer_C. If this is not possible, the secondary request is for Company to design
the engine so remote oil hoses can be screwed directly into the side of the block without an
